rationale: Do not promote. V3 places more checked units and requires fewer repairs overall, but introduces unsupported causes and promised follow-ups. Primary critical errors increase from two to three, including a new IT07 regression, while the administrative primary case loses placement. Total failed groups remain equal but newly affected IT06 and Shift17 courier groups require investigation. Frozen gate 2 fails; pooled gains do not override it. Keep v2 as default and release v3 only as an optional experiment.

gate_assessment.primary_placement_and_repairs: Aggregate improvement: 38 to 46 of 103 placed units; 68 to 59 repair operations. Administrative13 regresses from 3 to 2 placed units and 7 to 8 repairs.
gate_assessment.correctness: Fail: primary critical errors 2 to 3; new unsupported cause/commitment claims in Maintenance01, IT05 and IT07. IT07 had no recorded v2 correctness error. No recorded false-completion errors in either adapter.
gate_assessment.failure_accounting: Aggregate count condition met: incomplete cases 4 to 3, failed groups 4 to 4. New failures in IT06 and Shift17 courier require investigation; no missing/malformed/unexpected output groups reported and failed sources retained.
gate_assessment.reserved_decision: Development gate failed; do not run or semantically review reserved notes.

reviewer_note: Root decision with a separate AI-assisted gate consistency check after all 20 canonical reviews were completed. Practical model-label masking and prior familiarity limits are disclosed in the qualitative report and audit.
